why_it_passes: a setting on the person's own Mac, numbered to done, and the check reads that very setting from zm's view of the machine

input.title: Turn on daily zm updates on your Mac
input.brief:
1. Open Terminal on your Mac, bea-mac.
2. Run: zm update auto on
3. Run: zm update auto and confirm it prints: daily updates on.
4. Run: zm daemon restart so the change is reported to the team.
